decoded_frame_semantics: Every stored video frame was decoded in order without frame sampling. These PNGs derive from compressed video and are not byte-identical original observations. Frame IDs beginning video_ are annotation IDs, not native observation IDs; depth and per-frame robot pose remain unresolved.
